teacher: final1000_only; exact revised19train6dev; frozen strict checkpoint; no best-step selection

evaluation.zero_available_slot: reuse all-history output; report skipped forward counts
evaluation.utility: MAE(tile16,remove_slot)-MAE(tile16,all); available whole-slot LOO; raw and signed; target only for measurement
evaluation.aggregation: primary degraded effect equal-weight six sources and equal-weight three degraded profiles; signs on all five profiles; unavailable tiles excluded

rationale: An operational development screen for useful selective history: mean gain exceeds the existing neutral-utility margin, benefit appears in at least4/6 sources, and both useful and harmful tiles have nontrivial support across sources. The1% and3source support thresholds are newly preregistered engineering design choices, not statistical significance or a literature standard. No teacher outputs were inspected.
failure_action: Stop all three student admissions pending design review; preserve full negative result. Do not extend teacher steps, select earlier checkpoint, replace sources, pool strata or lower thresholds posthoc. Any revised hypothesis is a separately named experiment.
quality_limits: Passing is only teacher headroom for the matched development experiment. Report clean/near-clean harm and each profile/source, transitions, PSNR/LPIPS separately in full evaluation. No final restoration quality, calibration, generalization or omni claim.
